name: Energy ladder
summary: Loops ordered from bare to full: each one keeps the last and adds a layer, so the kit is an arrangement waiting to be dragged in order.
motif: One riff carried up the ladder: hinted in the first loop, complete by the middle, doubled at the top.
surprise: The top loop changes one chord of the riff, so it lands somewhere new.
ending: The last loop is the full arrangement.
